scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.deploy:http-api: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy --config examples/http-api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:lifecycle-api: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy --config examples/lifecycle/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:lifecycle-caller: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy --config examples/lifecycle/caller/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.release:check: bun run check && bun run test && bun run test:workers && bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/effect-platform-cloudflare package:smoke
scripts.release: bun run release:check && bun run tegami publish
